malayalam-bride.about: A fresh, luminous Kerala bridal look that lets the gold of the kasavu saree and temple jewellery shine. Skin stays dewy and natural, the eyes get a soft kohl definition, and the lips keep to warm, gentle tones for an elegant, timeless finish.
tips: Prep with a hydrating primer for humid weather
Keep the base light and dewy to match the kasavu saree
Line the waterline with smudge-proof kajal and wing it slightly
Add a gold shimmer to the centre of the lid
Finish with a coral nude lip and a waterproof setting spray

christian-bride.about: A soft, romantic look made for a white gown or silk saree and a veil. The focus is radiant, even skin, softly defined eyes and a rosy lip that photographs beautifully in daylight and in church.

shades.eyes: Champagne and soft brown, fluttery lashes

tips: Use a radiant base that photographs well against white
Keep eyes soft with champagne shimmer and brown crease
Apply individual lashes for a delicate effect
Choose a rose pink lip with a clear gloss topper
Set lightly so the skin stays glowy under the veil

tamil-bride.about: A rich, traditional look to match a Kanjeevaram silk and temple jewellery. Expect a flawless, long-wear base, bold kohl-lined eyes and a deep classic lip, balanced with warm blush so the look holds through long ceremonies.

shades.eyes: Deep bronze smoky eye, bold kajal

tips: Colour-correct dark circles before foundation
Build a bronze smoky eye to balance temple jewellery
Wing the kajal outwards for a classic South Indian eye
Fill lips with a long-wear deep red
Bake the T-zone so the base lasts through long rituals

iyengar-bride.about: A graceful, traditional look for madisar draping and temple jewellery. The base is clean and glowing, the eyes are framed with soft kohl, and the lips stay in warm rosy or red tones for a refined, classic bride.
tips: Keep the base minimal and matte
Define brows naturally
Apply thick kajal on the waterline
Use a maroon lip to complement the madisar
Finish with setting spray for long ceremonies

telugu-bride.about: A bright, festive bridal look that complements a silk saree and gold jewellery. A long-lasting base, defined eyes with a touch of shimmer and a warm red or maroon lip create a look that stays vivid through the muhurtham and beyond.
tips: Leave space at the brow centre for the kalyana tilakam
Use a gold cut crease with a red outer V
Line and tightline with waterproof kajal
Choose a brick red lip
Highlight the cheekbones softly

kannada-bride.about: An elegant look for a Mysore silk saree and traditional jewellery. Skin looks naturally radiant, the eyes are softly smoked and lined, and a warm lip ties the look together with the richness of the silk.
tips: Keep the base satin, not too matte
Blend bronze into the crease with gold on the lid
Add kajal and lashes
Apply a rosewood lip
Set with powder only where needed

maharashtrian-bride.about: A classic look made for a Paithani saree, nath and mundavalya. A smooth, glowing base, kohl-defined eyes and a bold red or deep pink lip give a confident, traditional bridal finish.
tips: Leave space for the chandrakor bindi
Keep eyes soft gold with a neat wing
Use a classic red lip
Add a peach flush for freshness
Use waterproof products around the eyes

reception-glam.about: A polished, high-glam evening look for the reception. Think a luminous, camera-ready base, sculpted cheeks, a softly smoked or shimmery eye and a statement lip — designed to glow under evening lights and flash photography.
tips: Prime and use a luminous full-coverage base
Build a dark smoky eye and press glitter on the lid
Pick either a nude or berry lip, not both bold
Strobe the cheekbones for stage lighting
Lock the look with setting spray

friend-of-bride.about: A soft, pretty look for the bridesmaid or close friend — festive enough for the celebration without competing with the bride. Fresh skin, a hint of shimmer on the eyes and a rosy or nude-pink lip keep it light and photo-ready.
tips: Keep the base light and dewy
Add one shimmer shade on the lid
Curl lashes and apply mascara
Finish with a pink nude gloss
Avoid upstaging the bride with bold colour

punjabi-bride.about: A bold, celebratory look to match a red lehenga and kaleere. A long-wear radiant base, dramatic winged or smoky eyes and a classic red lip create a striking bride who still looks fresh through a long, high-energy day.

shades.eyes: Bold smoky eye with colour pop

tips: Colour-correct and use full coverage for long events
Create a bold smoky eye, add a colour pop matching the lehenga
Apply dramatic lashes
Choose red or deep pink lips
Highlight generously for the glow

rajasthani-bride.about: A regal look inspired by Rajasthani royalty. A rich, warm base, deeply defined kohl eyes with gold accents and a deep red or berry lip complement heavy jewellery and a vibrant lehenga.
tips: Keep the base matte to hold with heavy jewellery
Use gold glitter on the lid with heavy kajal
Define brows strongly
Pick a deep maroon lip
Contour softly to balance the borla

bengali-bride.about: A traditional look built around the Bengali bride's signature details — a red-and-white saree, chandan art and a bold bindi. The base stays soft and glowing, the eyes are lined in kohl and the lip is a classic red.
tips: Keep the forehead clear for chandan alpana
Draw a sharp winged liner
Keep shadow minimal and soft brown
Use a bright red lip
Apply alpana designs last, after setting the base

north-indian-bride.about: A timeless, glamorous North Indian bridal look. A flawless, luminous base, softly smoked eyes with a hint of shimmer and a rich red or maroon lip balance heavy jewellery and an ornate lehenga.
tips: Prime and colour-correct
Blend a rose gold smoky eye
Add lashes and tightline
Apply a long-wear red lip
Highlight cheekbones and nose bridge

minimal-pastel-bride.about: A modern, minimal look for the bride who wants to look like herself, only more radiant. Dewy skin, soft pastel or champagne eyes and a nude-pink lip pair beautifully with pastel outfits and diamond jewellery.
tips: Use a skin tint instead of heavy foundation
Wash pastel shadow over the lid
Groom brows with clear gel
Use cream blush high on the cheeks
Finish with a soft pink nude lip

cocktail-look.about: A fun, party-ready look for cocktail nights. It pairs a luminous base and strobed high points with a metallic or coloured liner, finished with a bold berry or glossy nude lip — glamorous, modern and made for the dance floor.
tips: Start with a luminous base
Use a metallic lid or a coloured graphic liner
Strobe high points
Pair with a berry lip or nude gloss
Keep brows sharp and defined

mehendi-look.about: A bright, playful look for the mehendi. Fresh, glowing skin, a pop of colour or shimmer on the eyes and a soft coral or pink lip keep it cheerful and comfortable for a long, sunny celebration.
tips: Keep the base fresh and light
Add a colour pop (green, yellow or gold) to match the outfit
Use mascara instead of heavy lashes
Pick a coral or peach lip
Set lightly for a daytime glow

engagement.about: A soft-glam look for the engagement — polished and photo-ready without feeling heavy. A satin base, rose gold or champagne eyes and a mauve or pink-nude lip give a fresh, elegant finish that suits most outfits.
tips: Prep and prime for photographs
Use a satin, medium-coverage base
Blend rose gold or champagne on the lids
Add light lashes for definition
Finish with a mauve or pink nude lip and setting spray

party.about: A confident party look for evenings and functions. A smooth base, defined eyes with a touch of shimmer and a lip colour that matches your outfit make it easy to look put-together and photo-ready all night.
tips: Prime and use a long-wear base for evening events
Build a smoky or glitter eye
Contour and highlight for night lighting
Choose a bold lip or keep eyes bold with a nude lip
Lock everything with setting spray
